encoded: The offset column 00000000: is where the dump begins, see the gutter.
generator_cmd: printf %s "The offset column 00000000: is where the dump begins, see the gutter."  # prose mentioning a dump
oracle_cmd: printf "%s" "$encoded" | file -  # -> ASCII text: prose, no dump rows
oracle_plain: /dev/stdin: ASCII text, with no line terminators
